description: This file implements a Windows-specific socket waiter mechanism, managing socket events, network event translation, and wait logic for asynchronous socket operations within the starboard shared win32 platform layer.

classes.name: SbSocketWaiterPrivate
classes.description: Implements a Windows-specific socket event waiter, managing socket registration, event handling, and wait logic.

classes.name: SbSocketWaiterPrivate::Waitee
classes.description: Represents a socket registration with interests, callback, and context for the waiter.

classes.name: SbSocketWaiterPrivate::WaiteeRegistry
classes.description: Manages the collection of waitees and their associated socket events.

methods.name: TranslateNetworkBitIntoInterests
methods.description: Translates Windows network events into internal interest flags.

methods.name: DiscoverNetworkEventInterests
methods.description: Queries a socket for current network events and translates them into interest flags.

methods.name: EraseIndexFromVector
methods.description: Removes an element from a vector by swapping with the last element.

methods.name: CombineInterests
methods.description: Combines two interest flags using bitwise OR.
